name: Humanitarian funding gap
summary: WFP cut Gaza food aid for about 500,000 people from October; UNHCR reports shortfalls; no large-scale suspension found
state: WFP said on 19 Oct that funding cuts reduced the number it supports in Gaza from 1.6 million to 1.1 million and halved rations, and that it needs $450m to March 2027 (WFP). UNHCR's chief said on 12 Oct that its funding shortfall is affecting refugees worldwide (The Star). Searches on 12 Nov found no formal large-scale suspension of food or health aid in famine-risk countries, so the Alert line is not crossed.
for_you: Most directly affects refugees and people relying on food aid in Gaza, Sudan, Ethiopia and Somalia, where ration cuts tend to raise malnutrition. OCHA's Financial Tracking Service publishes appeal funding.
rubric_hit: Watch: major ration cuts announced (WFP Gaza, about 500,000 people cut); no pipeline break suspending aid at scale (Alert line)

sources.title: WFP — Funding cuts force WFP to drastically reduce lifesaving assistance in Gaza
The Star — UN refugee agency's funding shortfall is impacting refugees worldwide, its chief says

why: When appeals go unfunded, food aid and health services are cut first; funding gaps lead famine and displacement by months.
drivers: Donor budgets and aid cuts, new crises competing for funds, access constraints.

rubric.alert: Pipeline breaks forcing large-scale suspension of food or health aid in famine-risk countries.
rubric.watch: Funding more than 10 percentage points behind recent years at the same point, or major ration cuts announced.
rubric.normal: UN global appeal funding in line with recent years; no major ration cuts.
